parsed_profile.title: F-CLASS R0 AND R1 PLATFORM ULTRASONIC TESTING
parsed_profile.reason_for_revision: To communicate about updated recommendations specific to 7F and 9F R1 platform ultrasonic inspection interval and to update TIL language for clarity.
parsed_profile.purpose: To inform affected users about the recommendation to perform in-situ ultrasonic inspection of the R0 and R1 blade platforms for evidence of dovetail distress.
parsed_profile.compliance_category_text: Compliance Required - Identifies the need for action to correct a condition that, if left uncorrected, may result in reduced equipment reliability or efficiency. Compliance may be required within a specific operating time.
scope_of_work: Perform in-situ dovetail ultrasonic testing (DT-UT) of R0 blades on suction side and pressure side
Perform in-situ dovetail ultrasonic testing (DT-UT) of R1 blades on suction side
DT-UT may be performed concurrently with TIL 1509 and TIL 1603 inspections
Inspections typically require one to two 12-hour shifts
R0 DT-UT can typically be carried out in 12 to 16 hours following applicable cool down and inlet entry requirements
R1 DT-UT can typically be carried out within 12 hours following applicable cool down and inlet entry requirements
service_recommendation_line_items: 7F and 9F: Perform R0 and R1 DT-UT the sooner of 8,000 actual fired hours (FH) or 150 actual fired starts (FS) on a recurrent basis
7F and 9F peaking units performing more than 150 actual fired starts in a year: Conduct DT-UT just before and after the peak season
6F: Perform R0 and R1 DT-UT during the Major Inspection (MI), or at any opportunity when the upper-half compressor casing is removed
Units with ECP 2, 2+, 3 or 4 installed: Only R1 DT-UT is necessary since enhanced R0 blades have platform undercut feature
Units with ECP 5 installed: TIL is not applicable since both enhanced R0 and R1 blades have platform undercut feature
If positive indication during DT-UT, contact GE Gas Power Services representative to evaluate results
If R0 dovetail cracks confirmed, replace entire set of R0 blades even if indications limited to fewer blades
If R1 indications confirmed, rotor requires sending to GE Service Center to replace full set of R1 blades
May incorporate DT-UT during annual borescope inspection or forward compressor inspections per TIL 1509 and TIL 1603
parsed_profile.completion_criteria_text: This TIL can be considered complete when the R0 and R1 blades are replaced with blades with platform undercut feature.
parsed_profile.maintenance_trigger_text: Recurrent in-situ DT-UT at specified intervals until blades with platform undercut feature are installed.
recommended_interval_or_trigger: 7F and 9F: Sooner of 8,000 actual fired hours or 150 actual fired starts (recurrent)
7F and 9F peaking units (>150 starts/year): Just before and after peak season
6F: During Major Inspection (MI) or any opportunity when upper-half compressor casing is removed
parsed_profile.usage_counter_requirements_text: For 7F and 9F units, DT-UT to be performed the sooner of 8,000 actual fired hours (FH) or 150 actual fired starts (FS). For peaking units performing more than 150 actual fired starts in a year, conduct DT-UT just before and after the peak season.
parsed_profile.frame_or_model_applicability_text: Applicable to select 6F, 7F, and 9F gas turbines with an 18-stage compressor.
parsed_profile.hardware_or_part_configuration_text: Applicable to units operating with rotor Stage 0 (R0) and Stage 1 (R1) blades that do not have the platform undercut feature. Includes standard or non-enhanced R0 (including the P-cut R0) and R1 blades without the platform undercut feature.
parsed_profile.exclusions_or_non_applicable_conditions_: Not applicable to units with ECP 5 installed since both enhanced R0 and R1 blades have platform undercut feature. For units with ECP 2, 2+, 3 or 4, only R1 DT-UT is necessary since enhanced R0 blades have platform undercut feature.
parsed_profile.prerequisite_outage_or_inspection_contex: GE has the capability to perform the R0 and R1 DT-UT without casing removal for 7F and 9F. For 6F, upper-half compressor casing removal is required. Requires rotor rotation, applicable cool down and inlet entry requirements, and qualified confined space entry personnel.
parsed_profile.sbom_trigger_reason: TIL applicability depends on whether installed R0 and R1 blades have the platform undercut feature, and whether Enhanced Compressor Packages (ECP 2, 2+, 3, 4, or 5) are installed, requiring installed-configuration verification.

parts_referenced.context: R0 compressor rotor blades (standard or non-enhanced, including P-cut R0) without platform undercut feature
R1 compressor rotor blades without platform undercut feature
Enhanced Compressor Package (ECP) 2, 2+, 3, 4, or 5 - enhanced R0 and/or R1 blades with platform undercut feature

reference_documents.context: Forward compressor inspections; DT-UT may be performed concurrently with TIL 1509
Forward compressor inspections; DT-UT may be performed concurrently with TIL 1603

configuration_variables: R0 blade type (standard, P-cut, enhanced with platform undercut)
R1 blade type (standard, enhanced with platform undercut)
Enhanced Compressor Package version installed (ECP 2, 2+, 3, 4, or 5)
Operating profile (baseload vs. peaking with >150 starts/year)
parsed_profile.configuration_summary: Applicability and inspection scope depend on frame type, installed blade configuration (presence of platform undercut feature), and ECP version. 7F/9F have different interval requirements than 6F. Peaking units with >150 starts/year have additional seasonal inspection requirements. ECP 5 units are fully excluded; ECP 2/2+/3/4 units only require R1 inspection.
severity_signals: Compressor event due to R0 distress
parsed_profile.risk_summary: Fretting at the edge of contact region on R0 and R1 blade dovetails causes local stress increase leading to crack initiation and propagation. Once cracks grow to critical depth, there is increased potential for blade liberation and downstream compressor distress. A 9F unit experienced a compressor event in 2005 due to R0 distress originating from the suction side of the dovetail.

source_snippets.snippet: For 7F and 9F units, it is recommended that the R0 and R1 DT-UT be performed the sooner of 8,000 actual fired hours (FH) or 150 actual fired starts (FS).
Failure to comply with these recommendations may result in blade liberation and potentially result in downstream compressor distress.
This TIL can be considered complete when the R0 and R1 blades are replaced with blades with platform undercut feature.
For units that have installed ECP 5, this TIL is not applicable since both the enhanced R0 and R1 blades included in ECP 5 have the platform undercut feature.
This recommendation only applies to the standard or non-enhanced R0 (including the P-cut R0) and R1 blades without the platform undercut feature.
In 2005, a 9F unit experienced a compressor event due to R0 distress originating from the suction side of the dovetail.
GE has the capability to perform the R0 and R1 DT-UT without casing removal.
For peaking units performing more than 150 actual fired starts in a year, it is recommended to conduct the DT-UT just before and after the peak season.
